title: Mastermind Antagonist
body: Villain blueprint tracking public reputation, grand schemes, contingency plans, lieutenants, and the hubris that will undo them.

fields.name: Public Reputation
fields.hint: Why ordinary citizens or nobles trust or fear them

fields.name: Why They Believe They Are Right

sampleValues.Public Reputation: Celebrated as the generous architect of the city's floodgates and public granaries.
sampleValues.Why They Believe They Are Right: Convinced the approaching astral winter will wipe out half the realm unless all magic is rationed under one iron crown.
sampleValues.Master Plan & Escalation Milestones:
Phase 1 | Monopolize star-silver mines | Guilds go bankrupt
Phase 2 | Silence the Observatory | No warning before eclipse
sampleValues.Lieutenants & Leverage: Commands the Silenced Choir (debt-bound assassins) and holds blackmail over two Harbormasters.
sampleValues.Fatal Blindspot / Achilles Heel: Assumes sentimental loyalty is always weaker than coin, underestimating ordinary friendships.
